mutations.name: duration-agreement is reported only
kills: the render stage's duration-agreement gate fails a stage whose manifest has the page outlasting the mix

mutations.name: render skips the QA gate unless the variant asks for it
kills: the render stage gates on the qa profile by default, and records qaGate skipped under noQa

mutations.name: the style pack's CSS never reaches the render config
kills: the render stage serves a style pack's CSS from the page head, and no stylesheet without a pack

mutations.name: the twoRun param is dropped
kills: the render stage reports two-run as a failed, non-gating check when the second render's bytes differ
